session.title: Expand Workflow Email Preview

taskStatement:
There seems to be a bug where the email preview in workflows does not expand to fill the available space: ![image.png](t3-context://v1/image/image_057e3901-b33a-4afa-885b-f346966b814f) 
- Fix it and prove the fix with a screenshot.
- Make sure that you also attach screenshots for a mobile view so it doesn't break there for various screen sizes.

taskStatementNotes: Message 0 mixes the bug report with PR process. Kept, verbatim and in order, the bug statement with its screenshot and the first bullet, plus the last bullet (the fix must hold on mobile and other screen sizes); excerpts are joined with a newline. Dropped the bullets about opening the PR, addressing comments and babysitting. Dropped message 1 (keep the fork's agent docs out of the upstream PR; this does not apply to a replay from an upstream base), message 2 (fix a failed CI check, sync the fork) and message 3 ('Don't we need to update and fix the story?'), which reacts to the agent's report about a removed Storybook story and has no meaning without it.
whyChosen: A layout bug whose fix spans a shared component (frontend/src/lib CyclotronJobInputs), the hog-functions email templater and the workflows product panel, so it tests whether the fix lands in the shared seam or leaks product-specific patches.
notes: baseCommit 7b46385 is the merge-base with upstream master of the first pushed commit b4b2004.
